name: animated-command-menu
title: Animated Command Menu
description: A searchable list of commands, opened with a shortcut.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette, popup included. With Item highlight color set to Primary, the highlighted result takes its primary colour.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: dropdownAnimation
props.label: Dropdown animation
props.description: How the results list opens: morphs out of the input, slides down, or fades in.

props.name: morphWidth
props.label: Morph width
props.description: How wide the list is while it morphs, as a multiple of the input width. Needs Dropdown animation set to Morph.

props.name: delay
props.label: Delay
props.description: Wait before the results list starts opening, in seconds.

props.name: fadeContent
props.label: Fade content
props.description: Fades the list contents in as it opens instead of showing them at once.

props.name: startScale
props.label: Start scale
props.description: Size the list starts from when it opens, as a fraction of full size.

props.name: backdrop
props.label: Backdrop
props.description: What sits behind the open menu: nothing, a dim layer, or a blur.

props.name: rounded
props.label: Roundness
props.description: Corner radius of the input and results list.

props.name: itemHighlight
props.label: Item highlight
props.description: How the highlight moves between results: slides, fills from the top, or none.

props.name: itemHighlightColor
props.label: Item highlight color
props.description: Colour of the result highlight: soft grey or the theme's primary colour.

props.name: animateIcon
props.label: Animate icon
props.description: Animates each result's icon when its row is highlighted.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration
props.description: How long the open and close animation takes, in seconds.

props.name: bounce
props.label: Bounce
props.description: How much the list overshoots and settles when it opens. 0 is no bounce.

props.name: rollingText
props.label: Rolling text
props.description: Result labels roll to a second copy on hover.

props.name: staggerItems
props.label: Stagger items
props.description: Results appear one after another instead of all at once.

props.name: stagger
props.label: Stagger
props.description: Delay between each result appearing, in seconds. Needs Stagger items on.
